description.value: Coastal Kitchen Cafe is a beachy, laid-back eatery at Wild Coast Wilderness Resort in Port Renfrew, rated as having one of the best vibes on Vancouver Island. It focuses on handmade food with quality local ingredients — Drum Roaster coffee, freshly baked goods, and seasonal menus — alongside draught beer from Phillips Brewing. Touring cyclists will find a sunny patio, a log-burner interior for rainy days, and a retail nook stocking books and keepsakes from local artists.
